name: argyph
description: Local-first MCP server for fast, structured, and semantic code context

toolDescriptions.ask: Primary lookup router — routes bare identifiers to symbol search, paths to locate, NL questions to semantic search. Returns bounded Span results.
toolDescriptions.expand_span: Expand one truncated Span from a session handle returned by another tool.
toolDescriptions.get_index_status: Report the readiness of all index tiers (cheap, safe to poll)
toolDescriptions.get_repo_overview: Tier-0 summary: file tree, language mix, sizes
toolDescriptions.search_text: Pure regex/literal grep across the repo (Tier 0)
toolDescriptions.search_semantic: Hybrid BM25 + vector search over AST-aware chunks (Tier 2)
toolDescriptions.find_references: Find references for a symbol id or name (Tier 1)
toolDescriptions.get_callers: Functions calling a given symbol, grouped by caller (Tier 1)
toolDescriptions.get_callees: Functions called by a given symbol (Tier 1)
toolDescriptions.get_imports: Files imported by a file and files that import it (Tier 1)
toolDescriptions.get_symbol_outline: Hierarchical outline of a source file's symbols (Tier 1)
toolDescriptions.pack_repo: Token-budgeted XML/markdown pack of the repo for AI consumption
toolDescriptions.locate: Smallest natural span containing a structured path or NL query — code, markdown, JSON, YAML, TOML, CSV (Tier 1.5)
toolDescriptions.locate_smart: AI-guided multi-step locate (opt-in; requires provider config)
toolDescriptions.memory_save: Persist a memory entry under a scope with optional metadata
toolDescriptions.memory_search: Full-text search persistent memories, optionally scope-filtered
toolDescriptions.memory_forget: Delete a memory entry by id

author: Ezzy1630
